usage: trading_assistant.portfolio [-h] [--short N] [--long N] [--cash AMOUNT]
                                   [--fee AMOUNT] [--fee-pct PCT] [--json]
                                   [--weights SYMBOL=PCT [SYMBOL=PCT ...]]
                                   [--csv OUT]
                                   folder

Backtest the SMA crossover on every .csv file in a folder, with the cash split
equally (or by --weights), on the dates every file shares.

positional arguments:
  folder                folder whose .csv files (with 'date' and 'close'
                        columns) are the symbols

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --short N             short SMA window (default: 20)
  --long N              long SMA window (default: 50)
  --cash AMOUNT         starting cash, split equally between the files or by
                        --weights (default: 10,000)
  --fee AMOUNT          fixed cost per trade (default: 0)
  --fee-pct PCT         percent of traded value per trade (default: 0)
  --json                print one JSON object (summary, skipped files,
                        disclaimer) instead of the text
  --weights SYMBOL=PCT [SYMBOL=PCT ...]
                        split the cash by these percentages instead of
                        equally, e.g. A=60 B=40: one per file used, each above
                        0, adding up to 100
  --csv OUT             also write one row per shared date to OUT: date,
                        portfolio equity, then each symbol's equity

Research aid only. Not financial advice.

Backtest the SMA crossover on every .csv file in a folder, with the cash split
equally (or by --weights), on the dates every file shares.

positional arguments:
  folder                folder whose .csv files (with 'date' and 'close'
                        columns) are the symbols

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --short N             short SMA window (default: 20)
  --long N              long SMA window (default: 50)
  --cash AMOUNT         starting cash, split equally between the files or by
                        --weights (default: 10,000)
  --fee AMOUNT          fixed cost per trade (default: 0)
  --fee-pct PCT         percent of traded value per trade (default: 0)
  --json                print one JSON object (summary, skipped files,
                        disclaimer) instead of the text
  --weights SYMBOL=PCT [SYMBOL=PCT ...]
                        split the cash by these percentages instead of
                        equally, e.g. A=60 B=40: one per file used, each above
                        0, adding up to 100
  --csv OUT             also write one row per shared date to OUT: date,
                        portfolio equity, then each symbol's equity
